### gpt ##########################################################################

```{r}
gpt_full_filtered <- gpt_full %>% 
#  filter(Treatment == "Leber_Diclo") %>%
#  filter(!attribute == "GPT Day_Unknown") %>% 
  filter(!grepl("_From Start|_From Start|DBS", attribute))
gpt_full_filtered
```


```{r}
gpt_full_filtered %>%
  filter(grepl("Leber", Treatment)) %>% 
  group_by(Treatment) %>%
  summarise(total_unique = n_distinct(`Edited_BfArM Nummer2`))

```


```{r}
gpt_fullraw <- gpt_full_filtered %>% 
  unite(edited_tret,c(`Edited_BfArM Nummer2`, Treatment),sep = "_") %>% 
  mutate(edited_tret = as.factor(edited_tret) )


gpt_fullraw %>% 
   filter(grepl("Leber", edited_tret)) %>%
  group_by(edited_tret) %>%
  summarise(count = n())
```





```{r}


# Step 1: Prepare your data
gpt_full_filtered_prepared <- gpt_full_filtered %>% 
  mutate(
    Treatment = as.factor(Treatment),
    `Edited_BfArM Nummer2` = as.factor(`Edited_BfArM Nummer2`)
  )

# Step 2: Filter only treatments with "Leber" and count unique patients per group
group_counts <- gpt_full_filtered_prepared %>%
  filter(grepl("Leber", Treatment)) %>% 
  group_by(Treatment) %>%
  summarise(total_unique = n_distinct(`Edited_BfArM Nummer2`), .groups = "drop")

# Step 3: Calculate maximum labreads value per group (for positioning labels above the boxes)
y_pos <- gpt_full_filtered_prepared %>%
  filter(grepl("Leber", Treatment)) %>%
  group_by(Treatment) %>%
  summarise(y = max(labreads, na.rm = TRUE) * 1.05, .groups = "drop")

# Step 4: Join counts and y-positions into one dataframe
group_counts <- left_join(group_counts, y_pos, by = "Treatment")

# Step 5: Create the base plot (can use all data or filtered data)
liver_gpt_full_comparison_of_nsaid_groups <- ggbetweenstats(
  data = gpt_full_filtered_prepared %>% filter(grepl("Leber", Treatment)),  # plot only Leber treatments
  x = Treatment,
  y = labreads,
  type = "np",
  title = "liver_alt_full_comparison of ALT between NSAID-groups", # ALT for labvalue and daily dose",
       xlab = "NSAID intake",
       ylab = "ALT u/l", 
)

# Step 6: Add count labels to the plot
liver_gpt_full_comparison_of_nsaid_groups <- liver_gpt_full_comparison_of_nsaid_groups + 
  geom_text(
    data = group_counts,
    aes(
      x = Treatment,
      y = y,
      label = paste0("N = ", total_unique)
    ),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    size = 4,
    vjust = -0.5
  )
liver_gpt_full_comparison_of_nsaid_groups

dir.create("plots", showWarnings = FALSE)
svg("plots/liver_gpt_full_comparison_of_nsaid_groups.svg", height = 8, width = 6.5)
print(liver_gpt_full_comparison_of_nsaid_groups)
dev.off()
```

```{r}
leuk_full_filtered <- leukozyten_full %>% 
#  filter(Treatment == "Leber_Diclo") %>%
#  filter(!attribute == "leuk Day_Unknown") %>% 
  filter(!grepl("_From Start|_From Start|DBS", attribute))
leuk_full_filtered
```


```{r}
leuk_fullraw <- leuk_full_filtered %>% 
  unite(edited_tret,c(`Edited_BfArM Nummer2`, Treatment),sep = "_") %>% 
  mutate(edited_tret = as.factor(edited_tret) )


leuk_fullraw %>% 
   filter(grepl("Leber", edited_tret)) %>%
  group_by(edited_tret) %>%
  summarise(count = n())
```


```{r}


# Step 1: Prepare your data
leuk_full_filtered_prepared <- leuk_full_filtered %>% 
  mutate(
    Treatment = as.factor(Treatment),
    `Edited_BfArM Nummer2` = as.factor(`Edited_BfArM Nummer2`)
  )

# Step 2: Filter only treatments with "Leber" and count unique patients per group
group_counts <- leuk_full_filtered_prepared %>%
  filter(grepl("Leber", Treatment)) %>% 
  group_by(Treatment) %>%
  summarise(total_unique = n_distinct(`Edited_BfArM Nummer2`), .groups = "drop")

# Step 3: Calculate maximum labreads value per group (for positioning labels above the boxes)
y_pos <- leuk_full_filtered_prepared %>%
  filter(grepl("Leber", Treatment)) %>%
  group_by(Treatment) %>%
  summarise(y = max(labreads, na.rm = TRUE) * 1.05, .groups = "drop")

# Step 4: Join counts and y-positions into one dataframe
group_counts <- left_join(group_counts, y_pos, by = "Treatment")

# Step 5: Create the base plot (can use all data or filtered data)
liver_leuk_full_comparison_of_nsaid_groups <- ggbetweenstats(
  data = leuk_full_filtered_prepared %>% filter(grepl("Leber", Treatment)),  # plot only Leber treatments
  x = Treatment,
  y = labreads,
  type = "np",
  title = "liver_leuk_full_comparison of leuk between NSAID-groups", 
       xlab = "NSAID intake",
       ylab = "leuk cells/ul", 
)

# Step 6: Add count labels to the plot
liver_leuk_full_comparison_of_nsaid_groups <- liver_leuk_full_comparison_of_nsaid_groups + 
  geom_text(
    data = group_counts,
    aes(
      x = Treatment,
      y = y,
      label = paste0("N = ", total_unique)
    ),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    size = 4,
    vjust = -0.5
  )
liver_leuk_full_comparison_of_nsaid_groups

dir.create("plots", showWarnings = FALSE)
svg("plots/liver_leuk_full_comparison_of_nsaid_groups.svg", height = 8, width = 6.5)
print(liver_leuk_full_comparison_of_nsaid_groups)
dev.off()
```

### normality, variance, levene, welch summary ###
```{r}
while (sink.number() > 0) sink()

files <- list(
  gpt_full = gpt_full,
  got_full = got_full,
  ggt_full = ggt_full,
  ap_full = ap_full,
  total_bilirubin_full = total_bilirubin_full,
  direct_bilirubin_full = direct_bilirubin_full,
  ldh_full = ldh_full,
  ck_full = ck_full,
  quick_full = quick_full,
  inr_full = inr_full,
  ptt_full = ptt_full,
  leukozyten_full = leukozyten_full,
  erythrozyten_full = erythrozyten_full,
  thrombozyten_full = thrombozyten_full,
  hb_full = hb_full,
  hämatokrit_full = hämatokrit_full,
  gesamteiweiß_full = gesamteiweiß_full,
  crp_full = crp_full,
  kreatinin_full = kreatinin_full,
  harnstoff_full = harnstoff_full,
  natrium_full = natrium_full,
  kalium_full = kalium_full,
  kalzium_full = kalzium_full
)

sink("plots/results normality, variance, levene, welch.txt")

for (name in names(files)) {
  
  data <- files[[name]]
  
  # 🔹 HIER ist der Filter
  data <- data %>%
    dplyr::filter(grepl("Leber", Treatment))
  
  cat("\n============================\n")
  cat("Datensatz:", name, "\n")
  cat("============================\n\n")
  
  var <- "labreads"
  formula <- as.formula(paste(var, "~ Treatment"))
  
  cat("Normality Test (Shapiro-Wilk, abgesichert):\n")
  
  norm_res <- by(data[[var]], data$Treatment, function(x) {
    if (length(x) >= 3) {
      shapiro.test(x)
    } else {
      list(W = NA, p.value = NA)
    }
  })
  
  print(norm_res)
  
  cat("\nVarianz pro Gruppe:\n")
  print(tapply(data[[var]], data$Treatment, FUN = stats::var))
  
  cat("\nLevene-Test:\n")
  print(leveneTest(formula, data = data))
  
  cat("\nWelch ANOVA:\n")
  print(oneway.test(formula, data = data))
}

sink()
while (sink.number() > 0) sink()
```

### Kruskal-Wallis-Test summary ###
```{r}
while (sink.number() > 0) sink()
files <- list(
  gpt_full = gpt_full,
  got_full = got_full,
  ggt_full = ggt_full,
  ap_full = ap_full,
  total_bilirubin_full = total_bilirubin_full,
  direct_bilirubin_full = direct_bilirubin_full,
  ldh_full = ldh_full,
  ck_full = ck_full,
  quick_full = quick_full,
  inr_full = inr_full,
  ptt_full = ptt_full,
  leukozyten_full = leukozyten_full,
  erythrozyten_full = erythrozyten_full,
  thrombozyten_full = thrombozyten_full,
  hb_full = hb_full,
  hämatokrit_full = hämatokrit_full,
  gesamteiweiß_full = gesamteiweiß_full,
  crp_full = crp_full,
  kreatinin_full = kreatinin_full,
  harnstoff_full = harnstoff_full,
  natrium_full = natrium_full,
  kalium_full = kalium_full,
  kalzium_full = kalzium_full
)

results <- data.frame()

for (name in names(files)) {
  
  data <- files[[name]]%>%
    dplyr::filter(grepl("Leber", Treatment))
  
  var <- "labreads"
  formula <- as.formula(paste(var, "~ Treatment"))
  
  kw <- kruskal.test(formula, data = data)
  
  results <- rbind(
    results,
    data.frame(
      Dataset = name,
      Variable = var,
      Chi2 = unname(kw$statistic),
      df = unname(kw$parameter),
      p_value = kw$p.value
    )
  )
}

results
setwd("plots/")
write.table(results,
            file = "kruskal_results.txt",
            sep = "\t",
            row.names = FALSE,
            quote = FALSE)
while (sink.number() > 0) sink()
```
